title: Control Theory
description: Feed back too hard and a machine overshoots and rings; too gently and it drifts. Maxwell worked out where the line is. Unlocks the Governor.

puzzle.goal: A controller corrects an error e by a gain k each second. Write how much error E is left after t seconds of smooth correction.
puzzle.name: Exponential settling
puzzle.ask: Find E for e = @{e}, k = @{k} and t = @{t}.
puzzle.method: dE/dt = −kE: the error shrinks in proportion to itself, so it falls away exponentially.
